iko.text: Abda and his partner Rigi meet Brin, Lukka and Vivien Reid north of Drannith, and Abda greets Lukka with hostility, but when Vivien says that another planeswalker disturbed the Ozolith, he agrees to join out of loyalty to Brin.
At the Ozolith the bonders plan for Lukka to reach the central crystal while the others hold off the nightmares, and Abda and Rigi fight a black serpent-like guardian.
Abda saves Brin but is killed by a bolt from the skyship Vermilion, shot by Johannes with its ballistae, and the nightmares then overwhelm the hunters.
